author: _Phyre
body:
I was thinking... the monument, always have to break the obsidian.. whats the fun in that? Maybe capture the wool (I think CTW is in some maps :P) Maybe 1 monument 1 wool? I personally think it could be fun breaking the monument.. But having to come back alive with the wool as well... Just a suggestion :)

*I am totally getting hate for this aren't I :/
